overview: This enum decides whether a Simple Domain counter can catch an attack after its receive delay.

None.simple: A Simple Domain counter cannot catch this attack.
None.technical: None is the constructor default for AttackDataTable.SimpleDomainCounterReceiveType. FGameCharacterAction_AttackBase::CanBeCountered returns false for None once CounterReceiveTime is not positive. It also returns false while the delay timer is positive, regardless of type.

AttackActivate.simple: A Simple Domain counter can catch this attack only while the attack is active.
AttackActivate.technical: ActivateAttack sets bAttackActive and loads CounterReceiveTime from SimpleDomainCounterReceiveDelayTime in seconds. Tick decrements that timer while it is positive. Once the timer reaches zero, CanBeCountered returns the current bAttackActive value for AttackActivate.

Always.simple: A Simple Domain counter can catch this attack at any time after the delay.
Always.technical: Once CounterReceiveTime is not positive, CanBeCountered returns true unconditionally for Always. The delay timer is still seeded from SimpleDomainCounterReceiveDelayTime when the attack activates and is decremented in Tick.

Invalid.simple: An invalid Simple Domain counter setting.
Invalid.technical: Invalid is the 255 sentinel. CanBeCountered has cases only for None, AttackActivate, and Always. An assigned Invalid would therefore leave the switch and return false at the final return. No traced caller or exported Attack row assigns Invalid.

notes: The delay gate applies to every type. A positive CounterReceiveTime makes CanBeCountered return false before it reads the enum.
ActivateAttack sets bAttackActive and starts CounterReceiveTime from the attack row delay. Tick reduces that timer by DeltaTime while it is positive.
Exported Attack rows use None, AttackActivate, and Always. No exported row uses Invalid.
